method.actual_review: Read frozen contract, complete R7 proof, theory-code map and claims. Independently expanded projection and HD error identities by hand, checked all interval inequality directions and the endpoint Duhamel argument, and compared the source-state qualifications with inherited R4 events/species/source rows and the relevant R6 K/full-A distinction.

method.review_stopping_rule: One bounded theory pass; no new optional audits or replay requests after the stated proof obligations are satisfied.

reviewed_obligations.basis: Differentiating r=x-E_lift P x gives -E_lift_dot y, and PK=0, PE_lift=I imply r and all residual forcing remain in kerP. The coarse source difference and delta are retained.

Mean-value bounds on the declared convex whole-interval box give a,b,c. The l1 matrix measure retains signed diagonal entries and bounds the averaged coarse Jacobian. Monomial alpha_i=0 is treated before powers; zero densities and higher multiplicities are supported.

Nonexpansiveness supplies the ordinary cooperative comparison V. At the endpoint, Duhamel gives rho*R0 plus the reaction/source integral. Substituting V turns that integral into V1(H)-w01, hence T=exp(BH)-(1-rho)e1e1^T. No block factor multiplies late forcing.
For Metzler B and a>=0, the solution from e1 has nondecreasing first coordinate, so exp(BH)11>=1. Therefore T11>=rho>=0; other T entries and q are nonnegative even for d<0.

V(u) bounds interior times separately. T,q apply at valid endpoints; negative d does not justify using the endpoint as an earlier whole-block envelope. The optional weighted contraction estimate requires the separately stated Tp<=theta*p condition.
The positive two-state late-source example gives J*(1-exp(-gamma*epsilon))/(gamma*epsilon)>J*exp(-gamma*H) for 0<epsilon<=H. It refutes one incorrect update and is not a strong no-go.

The H/D/charge rows annihilate the declared exchange direction and have rank3. Matching invariant classes implies e=(-1,-1,1,1)*eta. Product differences yield eta'=-(kf*Um+dbar*Wm)*eta-w*d^T*r. The scalar coordinate has l1 coarse observable factor4.

The exact HD residual separates -w*Qpi*D*r from F0. Its operator norm is 2*max_i d_i*(1-pi_i); weighted mean absolute deviation is at most Delta_d/2. Whole-block upper and lower bounds produce the displayed a,b,c,d,g with correct inequality directions; d retains damping and is not clipped.

K-only rho is valid here because the entire state-dependent reset/destruction term is charged to aR. Absorbing it into the nominal generator requires a certificate for that full family. Same norm, state family, clock and H remain mandatory; state-dependent collider changes cannot be hidden.

R4 source labels actually distinguish para-H2(v0,j0) formation and thermal HD(v0,j0..8)/spin-weighted H2 products. The proof explicitly requires a new common-pool/state/branch matching and does not identify the source coefficients as a microscopic reverse pair. TIQM and SQM are alternatives; missing d_i/branch/consumer are not supplied by the theorem.

The augmented Metzler exponential contains the convolution and avoids B inverse. After the nonnegative shift, each omitted entry is bounded by the scalar norm tail. N+2>z justifies the geometric denominator. An outward rational exp(-sigma*H) upper and exact subtraction preserve the upper direction, including zero/singular B.

existing_assumptions_to_preserve: Finite dimension, declared regularity and a convex nonnegative whole-interval enclosure for both trajectories and mean-value segments.
P constant; nonnegative lift with P E_lift=I; PK=0; locally absolutely continuous lift.
Nominal K propagation nonexpansive on kerP on every relevant subinterval, plus a valid rho for the same block length H and clock.
All a,b,c,d,g bounds valid over the entire block; g_e=0 only for the exact same-source coarse ODE.
HD scalar adapter requires matching initial H/D/charge invariants and identical prescribed time-dependent kf,d,pi; scalar defect must be in span{s}.
Actual source state/ensemble, rates, branch, density/history and physical consumer remain separately input-pending; no physical admission follows from this conditional theorem.
Augmented numerical coordinates use explicit scaling, positive-tail truncation satisfies N+2>z, and the exp primitive is outward.
